title: Design Soundboard — Component usage journeys, edge-case recipes, and migration checklist
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a compact, example-first documentation hub (the 'Design Soundboard') that surfaces canonical usage journeys for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts; documents common edge cases and anti-patterns; and provides a step-by-step migration checklist for teams upgrading from legacy token names and legacy component props. The goal is to lower friction for product teams during component upgrades and reduce regressions in production caused by mismatched styling, spacing, or API surface changes.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a dedicated Soundboard page with 6 usage journeys (onboarding, dense form, data table, dashboard chart, mobile form, and accessibility-first flows)
Each journey includes at least one live code example, one do/don't pair, and a short migration note where relevant
Migration checklist mappings for tokens (color, spacing, typography) and component prop changes for buttons/tables/charts are documented and validated by QA
Design + Engineering sign-off recorded in comments and linked PR numbers included
Docs page included in sidebar nav and surfaced in internal changelog
notes: Rationale: existing docs are fragmented across component pages and lack cross-component usage patterns; shipping a single navigable entrypoint helps teams reason end-to-end
Target audience: product engineers doing an incremental migration, frontend PMs, adoption champions in partner teams
Tone: prescriptive and example-focused; avoid exhaustive API dumps on the Soundboard — link to component reference for details
Prefer live playground embeds (CodeSandbox / StackBlitz) for patterns that exercise token theming and responsive behavior
steps: Draft initial Soundboard layout and six canonical journeys (Design)
Pair with ENG to add live playground scaffolding and ensure token runtime toggles (light/dark/compact)
Create migration mapping tables: legacy-token -> new-token, legacy-prop -> new-prop, and code mods examples
Implement 'do/don't' visual pairs for each journey and record accessibility notes (contrast, focus order)
Run cross-team review (Design, Docs, Engineering) and collect feedback
Publish behind feature-flag and invite two partner teams to try the migration checklist
Iterate on feedback, finalize copy, and remove feature-flag
decision_log: 2024-11-20: Chose example-first format over exhaustive reference — rationale: reduces cognitive load for migrating engineers (recorded by Aisha)
2024-12-05: Agreed to surface only 6 journeys on the Soundboard; deeper component examples remain on component pages (decision during sync with PM)
2025-01-10: Decided to adopt temporary compatibility CSS variables for two high-risk tokens (#brand-500 and spacing-xl) to avoid widespread breaks during rollout
2025-02-18: Engineering requested code mod snippets be provided as both jscodeshift and sed examples — approved
review_feedback: PM (Mariana Ortiz): Add explicit rollback steps to the migration checklist if regressions are detected
Engineering (Carlos Mendes): Need clear semantics for 'compact' spacing token; proposed token spacing-compact -> spacing-2x mapping
Accessibility (Priya Shah): Include test cases focused on keyboard navigation in dense forms and provide programmatic focus examples
Docs (Liam O'Connor): Suggest linking to runtime performance notes for table virtualization when showing large-data examples
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams may partially apply token mappings and end up with visual regressions — Mitigation: Provide an automated visual diff script and a sample GitHub Action to run on PRs
Risk: Soundboard examples diverge from actual component behavior in product repos — Mitigation: Add a CI check that runs the same build pipeline used by component packages and surface mismatches
Risk: Overload of content on the Soundboard — Mitigation: Keep narrative short, link to deeper docs, and instrument internal analytics to track most-used journeys
